fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-08-23 states that a caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 9,900 was withdrawn, on 2026-08-23 around 14:05 hrs. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100097 as the destination of the transfer. A witness, Kishore Selvam, reachable on 9000000323, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Venkat Prakash, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000439, in connection with the events. Nithya Devi (9000000109), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent KYC-update message allegedly used to collect account credentials.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, afternoon, digital document, mobile number, suspect, associate, receiving account
